<!-- pr-reviewer: 204a45d6ae60b9f50d61c49acff863ebb6ddc584 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Test-only PR (one new suite plus a decision file); no source, process, golden or snapshot changes. Not under the safety floor: it pins existing behaviour and changes no generator, check or post code.

**What looks good**
- Pins the contract through the posted G-code text, not just setup names, and covers redo plus a second undo.
- Second test covers the first-setup case (what `None` resolves to).
- Test is in `crates/app/tests/`, imports app-defined commands and `setup`; Gate map names it. Decision entry `docs/decisions/1362-delete-setup-undo-order.md` is present with considered-and-dropped. `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #1362`.

**Local results (merged with current main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_delete_order` | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

`.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` reads 47, unchanged by this PR (no process files touched).

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The test file uses `panic!`/`expect` helpers, acceptable in tests.
- The first test's sort-order assumption will need revisiting if an explicit setup position is ever added, as the decision file says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 204a45d6ae60b9f50d61c49acff863ebb6ddc584 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.21 (75k tokens)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 75k | ~$0.21 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
Effort: effort:medium
